header.title: Welcome to JW Backup
header.subtitle: Tool to compare and merge JW Library backups. Select two files (.jwlibrary), detect conflicts and apply choices before generating the final file.
header.tip: Quick tip: load files A and B, click "Detect conflicts" and use the choices to generate the merge.

modal.successBody: Your backup file was generated successfully. Click the button below to download and follow instructions to install in JW Library.
modal.restoreTitle: How to restore/use the merged file
modal.restore1: Download the file using the button above.
modal.restore2: Make a backup copy of your current .jwlibrary file before replacing.
modal.restore3: Replace the old file with the new one in the same location or import the new file into the app.
modal.restore4: If something goes wrong, restore the backup copy you saved in step 2.

conflictReview.title: Review choices before merge
conflictReview.help: Review each conflict, edit the result manually if needed and add a note. Then click "Confirm and generate merge".
